newsitem.title: USA: Illinois jobless rates drops in October.
newsitem.headline: Illinois jobless rates drops in October.

text.p: Illinois' unemployment rate fell slightly to 5.1 percent in October from 5.3 percent in September, the state's department of employment security reported Tuesday.
Figures released by the department showed 313,975 workers unemployed last month, compared to 322,870 in September. The October 1995 unemployment rate was 5.2 percent with 316,854 people without jobs.
The department also reported a gain of 20,210 jobs in October, bringing employment to 5.8 million.

"Job growth in Illinois continues a year-long, moderate trend in October, paced by robust hiring in trade and services and gains across other industries, including manufacturing, services and finance, insurance and real estate," said Lynn Doherty, the department's director, in a news release.
